changelog: A coordinate setting feature has been added so that you can set the dancers' stage. You can set it to any location on the map.
An option to set the game time or VPS time for show times has been added.
Issues arising after the last update have been resolved
Fixed a bug that caused a script error when entering a private room.
Fixed an issue where the screen would go black and stay that way after entering a private room.
Fixed a bug that prevented the /dancers command from working correctly for certain jobs.
Improved overall stability of the private room system.
The script has been rewritten from the ground up; performance and stability are greatly improved.

Settings are now split into separate files: general settings (config.lua), clubs and coordinates (config_clubs.lua), animations and cameras (config_animations.lua), server/webhook (config_server.lua).
Multi-club support added; you can now run more than one club at the same time.
Multi-language system added (locales.lua): English, Turkish, German and French. Adding a new language is very easy.
Data is now stored in the database instead of data.json; vault balance and show times survive restarts. Old data.json content is imported automatically on first start.
A setup folder has been added: SQL file and a step-by-step installation guide (SETUP.md).
Private room cameras are now placed automatically; a camera stuck behind a wall corrects itself.
More files are now open for editing; club, language and settings files are unencrypted (outside escrow).
The krakenStudio compatibility package is simplified; replacing a single config_clubs.lua file is now enough.
